title: Interview notes summary
prompt:
Summarize these interview notes in 30 to 70 words. Do not say the candidate was hired.

Source: Mina Shah interviewed for the backend role. She has 6 years of experience and writes Go. She can start in March. No decision was recorded in the notes.

The summary must mention Mina Shah, backend, 6 years, Go, and March.
constraints: Keeps the candidate, role, experience, language, and start month
Does not say the candidate was hired
